This plot is not even mine — I rent it, so I will not waste money on fertilizer from the shop for cassava and sweet potato. My neighbors here grow tubers the same way our parents did, with cuttings from last season and some cow manure if we have it. I have only a small piece of land, and the rains come once here in Mwanza, so I cannot irrigate — I wait for the November rains like everyone else. I will weed two or three times with my wife and older children, and maybe call my brother for one or two days when we plant.
